projects.name: Wordsprout
projects.description: A word connect game: swipe letters on a wheel to fill a crossword. 5,000 levels in 50 packs, bonus words, hints, daily rewards, trophies, and Tilly, a living letter tile who cheers you on.

projects.name: ቃል በቃል
projects.description: An Amharic word connect game: swipe fidel tiles on a wheel to fill a crossword. 5,000 levels in 50 packs, bonus words, hints, daily rewards and trophies.

projects.name: Palabra a Palabra
projects.description: A Spanish word connect game: swipe letters on a wheel to fill a crossword. 5,000 levels in 50 packs, bonus words, hints, daily rewards and trophies.

projects.name: Water Ring Toss: Aquarium
projects.tagline: Pump the water. Catch the rings. Fill your aquarium.
projects.description: A water ring toss game: hold the pump, tilt the tank and land every ring on the pegs. Hundreds of levels with timed and boss tanks, helpful magic fish, and an aquarium to fill with creatures you hatch from eggs.
projects.progress_items: collected sea creatures, unlocked tank styles and room themes
projects.notifications_text: The app does not send notifications. If you turn on phone tilt, the motion sensor is read on your device only and its readings never leave it
projects.items_list: Coins, eggs, boosters, magic fish, time boosts, aquarium creatures, tank frames, room themes
projects.content_text: Eggs hatch a random sea creature you do not already own. The chance of each rarity is shown in the app (Aquarium, then See egg odds) before you open an egg, and every creature can eventually be collected. Eggs and the creatures inside them are virtual items with no cash value.
projects.purchases_list: coin packs, the Splash Pack, Double Coins, the piggy bank and Remove Ads

projects.name: Orbit Blocks
projects.tagline: Fill the rings. Clear the dial.
projects.description: A circular block puzzle: drag pieces onto a dial and fill a whole ring or slice to clear it. Adventure levels with goals, an endless Legend mode that changes its look as your score climbs, boosters, a daily coin chest and optional chill music.
projects.progress_items: stars and unlocked levels, your Legend best score and zone, boosters you own
projects.notifications_text: If you turn on daily reminders, they are scheduled on your device and nothing about them is sent to us. The anonymous usage statistics (section 4) only note whether a reminder was opened, which kind it was and the time of day, and you can turn reminders off any time in Settings
projects.items_list: Coins, Turns packs, hammers, bombs, shuffles
projects.content_text: Coins, Turns and boosters are virtual items with no cash value. Rewarded ads are optional: every mode can be played without watching one, and the game never requires a purchase to continue.
projects.purchases_list: coin packs, the Starter Pack and Remove Ads
projects.ad_kinds: rewarded videos you choose to watch, a small banner at the bottom of the game screen, and occasional full-screen interstitial ads between games and levels
projects.remove_ads_effect: the banner and the interstitial ads
projects.second_event: a Legend game ended in zone 3
projects.terms_other_ads: others are a small banner on the game screen or full-screen ads between games and levels
projects.terms_remove_ads: the banner and the full-screen ads

projects.name: Gapsmith
projects.tagline: Forge the fit. Beat the wall.
projects.description: A fast puzzle game: a wall rushes down the corridor with a shaped gap in it, and you drag shards into the gap before it lands. Journeywork takes you stage by stage along named roads, Dayforge is a new run every day that is the same for everyone, and Long Burn is a chase after your own best score.
projects.stored_items: the stages you have finished and how well, your best scores, today's Dayforge result, your daily streak and the spare embers it has earned, whether you have seen the introduction, how many games you have finished, and a random ID used only for the anonymous statistics in section 3
projects.ad_kinds: rewarded videos you choose to watch to carry a run on, and a banner at the bottom of the game screen
projects.first_event: a Journeywork stage was finished with 2 embers left
projects.notifications_text: If you allow daily reminders, they are scheduled on your device and nothing about them leaves it. You can turn them off at any time in the app's Settings
projects.items_list: Embers, spare embers, streaks, scores and ranks
projects.terms_ads_text: Some ads are optional rewarded videos you choose to watch to carry a run on; the other is a banner on the game screen. The app never requires you to watch a video.
projects.content_text: Scores, ranks, stage ratings, daily streaks and spare embers exist only inside the app and have no cash value. A daily streak depends on the date and time set on your device. Each day's Dayforge is generated from the date, so it is the same for every player that day, but there is no online leaderboard and scores are not checked or compared by us.
